title: Not There, Not So
label: ch:ml-alla
canDo: I can say that something is not what it was called, and I can check something I think I already know.

payoff.summary: From cold: both negatives and the question each one answers, and the tag built from the second of them.
payoff.note: The chapter introduces exactly these three atoms and the payoff assesses all three. No new noun is added: adhyaapakan and aanu carry every example, and alle is built on alla so the second lesson confirms what the first made possible.
